title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust isn't just a benchmark—it's a protocol that embeds trustworthiness directly into navigation systems, ensuring safer, more reliable AI movement.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential because it quantifies trustworthiness across diverse environments, revealing flaws in protocols like NavTrust that assume uniform conditions.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust uses real-world datasets and adversarial testing, proving its robustness in scenarios like crowded streets or unpredictable obstacles.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Without standardized benchmarking, protocols like NavTrust remain unverifiable—how can we measure progress if we don’t compare against objective metrics?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Benchmarking sets the standard; NavTrust can’t claim superiority without it.
